_metadata.description: Controlled vocabulary for effect-direction labels. Numerical multipliers are retained for legacy v3 reference compatibility; production v4 owns its own scoring weights.
_metadata.purpose: Canonical effect-direction labels; multiplier values are legacy v3 reference weights, not the production v4 scoring contract.
_metadata.alignment: Study IDs: backed_clinical_studies.json effect_direction. Legacy v3 weights: scripts/config/scoring_config.json. Production v4: scripts/scoring_v4/config/quality_score.json effect_direction_multipliers.

field_contract.id: Stable snake_case identifier (or 'null' literal for studies with no effect_direction).
field_contract.name: User-facing label.
field_contract.multiplier: Legacy v3 reference weight, matching scoring_config.json; production v4 does not read this field.

effect_directions.name: Strong positive
effect_directions.notes: Studies show consistent, statistically significant benefit on primary outcomes.

effect_directions.name: Weak positive
effect_directions.notes: Studies show benefit on some outcomes but inconsistent or small effect sizes.

effect_directions.name: Mixed evidence
effect_directions.notes: Studies show conflicting results: some show benefit, others show no effect.

effect_directions.name: Null effect
effect_directions.notes: Studies do not show a statistically significant effect. This is not evidence of a positive benefit.

effect_directions.name: Negative effect
effect_directions.notes: Studies show harm or worse outcomes versus placebo or control.
